stories.title: Nitanshi Goel walks for Suneet Varma at LFW
stories.summary: Actress Nitanshi Goel served as the showstopper for Suneet Varma at Lakme Fashion Week 2026. She wore a wine-coloured embellished fishtail lehenga from the designer's Kashi collection, which the brand says is inspired by the city's heritage, colours and craftsmanship. The spotlight was successfully stolen.

stories.title: Sonam Bajwa wears Bandhani to Gucci event
stories.summary: Actress Sonam Bajwa attended a recent Gucci evening wearing a red Bandhani-inspired saree. The Punjabi star continues to balance contemporary glamour with traditional ethnic elegance. The look featured intricate white patterns, proving that a saree can hold its own at a high-profile luxury fashion gathering.

stories.title: Reliance Industries presents Payal Pratap collection
stories.summary: Reliance Industries brand R Elan presented designer Payal Pratap’s collection at Lakme Fashion Week 2026. The showcase combined advanced textile technologies with contemporary design to demonstrate how sustainable materials inspire artistic storytelling. The collection was titled Memories Pressed in Time, featuring the brand's proprietary fibre and fabric technology.

stories.title: Nehru’s wardrobe remains a study in consistency
stories.summary: Jawaharlal Nehru is remembered for his political contributions and his distinct sartorial identity. His signature white achkan, churidar, Gandhi cap and red rose became defining elements of his appearance. His wardrobe was never particularly elaborate, but it was remarkably consistent, influencing how Indian menswear balances tradition and refinement.

stories.title: FDCI promotes Indian textiles at Egypt Fashion Week
stories.summary: The Fashion Design Council of India is taking its textile heritage initiative to Egypt Fashion Week with Rahul Singh’s SUTRA collection. The council previously showcased pashmina and kantha at Lakme Fashion Week in Delhi. The organisation is now focused on promoting Indian designers on the international stage.

stories.title: Amit Aggarwal relaunches AM:IT line
stories.summary: Designer Amit Aggarwal has relaunched his prêt line, AM:IT, following a pandemic-induced hiatus. The designer, known for using recycled plastic and industrial materials, opened a flagship store in Mumbai. Aggarwal maintains that good design alone is insufficient to build a sustainable fashion business in the current climate.

stories.title: Canadian cafe brand blenz enters India
stories.summary: Actors Jackky Bhagnani and Rakul Preet Singh have partnered with Invision Brands to bring Canadian cafe chain blenz to India. The first outlet has opened in Mumbai. The expansion is being spearheaded by UpLyv Global Ventures, which aims to drive the brand's growth in the Indian market.

stories.title: India faces competitiveness challenge in apparel
stories.summary: India is looking to leverage free trade agreements to increase apparel exports. Success will depend on the competitiveness of manufacturers regarding quality, delivery and price. While Bangladesh has achieved scale in specific categories, India must now focus on building capabilities to compete consistently on the global stage.

stories.title: Alexander Skarsgard attends Deadline Contenders
stories.summary: Actor Alexander Skarsgard appeared at the Deadline Contenders Film event to promote his project Wicker. He wore a mint-bubblegum outfit, continuing a trend of notable red carpet appearances. The event spotlighted the cast and crew of 15 major films from the past year.

stories.title: Jennifer Lawrence pairs leopard print with red
stories.summary: Jennifer Lawrence has adopted a new styling method for leopard print by pairing it with the color red. The actor suggests this combination feels both classic and fresh. The look is intended to dominate the approaching cold-weather season and remain relevant well into the new year.

stories.title: Hunter Schafer begins Blade Runner 2099 tour
stories.summary: Hunter Schafer has commenced the press tour for Blade Runner 2099. Working with stylist Dara, the actor has worn a series of vintage finds and runway pieces. The miniseries is scheduled for release on November 25, following a year of high-profile global rollouts and method dressing.

stories.title: Katy Perry and Justin Trudeau attend gala
stories.summary: Katy Perry and Justin Trudeau attended the Baby2Baby Gala in Los Angeles. Perry wore a sequined minidress from Antonio Grimaldi’s spring 2025 couture collection, while Trudeau opted for a classic suit. The pair continues to maintain a consistent formula of maximalist fashion paired with traditional tailoring.

stories.title: Stars embrace formal wear at recent events
stories.summary: Recent red carpet appearances at the GQ Men of the Year Awards featured formal looks accented with bright colors and ties. Ayo Edebiri wore a pinstriped suit paired with a mint shirt and red tie. The trend leans into glamorous fun for the upcoming holiday party season.

stories.title: Turkish designer Atıl Kutoğlu showcases 2027 collection at Turkish embassy in Egypt - City Lights - Life & Style - Ahram
Camille Charriere updates 2003 outfit formula
stories.summary: Influencer Camille Charriere has recreated a 2003 outfit originally worn by Kate Moss. The look consists of skinny jeans, a navy knit, knee-high boots and a Balenciaga bag. The ensemble is cited as an enduring formula for chic dressing, two decades after its initial debut.

stories.title: Brooke Shields’ jeans, puffers? Met Gala’s show celebrates everyday fashion - South China Morning Post
Red Carpet Fashion Awards lists weekly favorites
stories.summary: The Red Carpet Fashion Awards has compiled a list of best-dressed stars for the week of November 14. Featured looks include Anya Taylor-Joy in vintage Pierre Cardin and Sofia Carson in Francesco Scognamiglio. The selection highlights a range of designers from Dior to Schiaparelli.

stories.title: November birthstones topaz and citrine highlighted
stories.summary: November is celebrated with two birthstones, topaz and citrine, both noted for their golden hues. Topaz is also available in blue shades. Ancient Greeks historically attributed protective qualities to topaz, while the stones are currently being featured in various contemporary jewellery and watch designs.

stories.title: RE:FINE Holiday 2026 showcases contemporary fine jewelry
stories.summary: The Museum of Arts and Design is hosting RE:FINE Holiday 2026, a shopping event featuring 23 international artists. The museum describes the event as a playground for collectors. It launches during NYC Jewelry Week, offering attendees 20 percent savings storewide. The playground opens on November 18.

stories.title: Adam Neeley designs earrings after a dream
stories.summary: Laguna Beach jeweler Adam Neeley designed a pair of earrings after dreaming of a blue butterfly in a garden. He sketched the pieces after waking from a series of dreams inspired by a dinner party. The earrings are one-of-a-kind, according to the designer.

stories.title: Keemti Jewels launches Stacks of Success collection
stories.summary: Keemti Jewels has introduced Stacks of Success, a collection of rings and charms featuring lab-grown diamonds. The brand says the line is inspired by women who build legacies one milestone at a time. The jewelry is intended for both everyday wear and special occasions.

stories.title: Nungu Diamonds clarifies Miss South Africa crown origin
stories.summary: Nungu Diamonds issued a statement clarifying that it did not design, craft, or supply the 2026 Miss South Africa crown. The clarification followed social media commentary regarding the headpiece worn by the new titleholder. The company noted the crown was not theirs.

stories.title: Boghossian high jewelry collection honors female rulers
stories.summary: Boghossian has released a high jewelry collection featuring necklaces, rings, and earrings inspired by historical female rulers. The brand cites Empress Mumtaz Mahal, the namesake of the Taj Mahal, as a primary influence. The collection uses diamonds and precious gemstones to pay tribute to the past.

stories.title: Disco era jewelry remains popular
stories.summary: Cartier, Bvlgari, and Tiffany & Co. are among the brands whose designs from the 1970s disco era remain in production. Designer Renato Cipullo recalls the period as a time of frequent parties. These pieces are now marketed as timeless classics by the original luxury houses.

stories.title: Ekatra Retail Ventures makes its lab-grown diamond jewellery debut with Ekatra Jewels - The Retail Jeweller India
Celebrities bring the spotlight on top jewellery brands across fashion showcases and outings - The Retail Jeweller India
These celebrities are making a compelling case for tanzanite jewellery - Prestige Online - Singapore
Hunter Schafer wears hair-matching earmuffs
stories.summary: Actor Hunter Schafer recently appeared in a pair of fuzzy earmuffs designed to match her hair. The accessory originated from Undercover’s fall 2007 collection. The look was styled for a press tour promoting a forthcoming science fiction series.

stories.title: I’ve Lived on the French Riviera for 20 Years,This Is the 1 Timeless Accessory French Women Always Wear - Travel + Leisu
French women and the popularity of silk scarves
stories.summary: Silk scarves are currently being styled by French women using a Parisian knot, which involves folding the fabric and pulling ends through a loop. Historic brands and designers continue to produce the prints. The accessory is described as simple fashion science for pulling together a look.

stories.title: M&S suggests triangle scarves for winter
stories.summary: Retailer M&S is promoting the triangle scarf as a winter accessory. The brand suggests that while base layers provide practicality, outer layers define personality. The styling advice involves draping the scarf around the neck and tying it, as jackets are no longer worn open.

stories.title: Luxury accessories marketed as aging well
stories.summary: Brands including Berluti, Patek Philippe, and Louis Vuitton are positioning their leather goods and watches as investment pieces. The companies claim these items develop a rich patina and character over time. These accessories are described as the building blocks of a permanent wardrobe.

stories.title: Our editors’ 10 favorite watches to elevate any outfit, starting at $79 - CNN
Balenciaga City Bag remains a fixture
stories.summary: Twenty-five years after its debut, the Balenciaga City Bag remains in production. The slouchy, studded design was initially considered an outlier in a market favoring structured bags. Mary-Kate Olsen and other figures have been associated with the carryall, which continues to be sold.

stories.title: Great Salt Lake fashion show raises over $1 million
stories.summary: A fashion collection inspired by the Great Salt Lake ecosystem was presented at a runway event in Utah. The 21 looks included coats and gowns designed to represent local wildlife and landscapes. The event raised over $1 million in support of the lake.

stories.title: Centre plans to expand global reach for Kutch artisans
stories.summary: Union Textiles Minister Giriraj Singh said the government aims to expand export opportunities for Kutch handicrafts and handlooms. Singh described artisans as custodians of India’s cultural heritage and stated that connecting traditional crafts with contemporary designs for international markets remains a priority for the government.

stories.title: The Bindi Project doubles annual revenue to 20 lakh
stories.summary: Meghna Khanna launched The Bindi Project in December 2022 with a 5 lakh investment. The venture recorded 20 lakh in revenue for FY25, doubling its previous year’s performance. The brand has served over 1,500 customers across India since its inception. A grandmother’s accessory is now a business.

stories.title: Austin Aimankhu: Championing sustainable fashion - Vanguard Allure
Victorian women and the anti-feather fashion campaign
stories.summary: The Royal Society for the Protection of Birds was founded by Victorian women as an anti-fashion movement against the global craze for bird-adorned hats. While these women were largely written out of the society’s history, their campaign against the feather trade remains in fashion archives worldwide.

stories.title: Margaret Nashipae wins circular fashion competition
stories.summary: Kenyatta University student Margaret Nashipae won the inaugural RE: IMAGINED fashion show in Nairobi. The competition featured 15 designers creating collections from textile remnants and second-hand materials. The event was a collaboration between academic institutions and textile organizations to promote sustainable fashion and recycling.

stories.title: National Lottery funds sustainable fashion project
stories.summary: Restitch the Future, a four-year project delivered by Bath Spa University and A Single Thread, has launched with National Lottery funding. The initiative aims to reach 250,000 people across the UK to make sustainable fashion more accessible. The project is supported by the Climate Action Fund.

stories.title: Marr College pupils attend sustainable fashion conference
stories.summary: Pupils from Marr College attended the Future Textiles Youth Conference at Dumfries House on November 9. The event, hosted by The Kings Foundation and Fashion Council Germany, focused on reuse, repair, and upcycling. Students met with international peers to discuss their role in shaping a sustainable future.

stories.title: Emma Watson wears biodegradable gown to gala
stories.summary: Emma Watson attended the 2026 LACMA Art+Film Gala in a corseted gown made of biodegradable textiles. Designed by Caroline Zimbalist and constructed by Rae Moore Studio, the dress featured two thigh-high slits. The look was intended to put experimental, eco-friendly materials at the center of the event.

stories.title: Sustainable and size-inclusive brand profile
Marie Curie store launches sustainable fashion pop-up
stories.summary: A Marie Curie charity shop in Swansea has converted into a last-chance store for three months. The shop is selling surplus clothing items for as little as 20p to encourage reuse. The initiative aligns with Sustainable Fashion Week by offering reduced prices on inventory that failed to sell.

stories.title: Titan shifts strategy as gold price gains slow
stories.summary: Titan Company is pivoting toward buyer growth after jewellery division sales moderated in the second quarter of FY27. Management attributed the slowdown to a shift in the festive calendar and lower demand for gold investment products. The retailer now plans to focus on more affordable product lines.

stories.title: eBay report notes surge in vintage fashion demand
stories.summary: eBay’s latest trend report indicates a rise in demand for archival fashion as creative director changes at major houses drive interest in past collections. Searches for designers including Matthieu Blazy and Jonathan Anderson have increased, providing new opportunities for small businesses to capitalize on the resale market.

stories.title: Fashion brands expand AI model use as agencies warn of job and rights risks - Traders Union
Gucci Is Cutting Prices. Louis Vuitton Is Reluctant to Follow the Trend. - WSJ
Textile recovery summit addresses overproduction
stories.summary: Founders and investors gathered at the Textile Recovery Summit to discuss solutions for the industry’s mounting waste. The event featured a pitch competition for technologies designed to sort, repair, and recycle discarded clothing. Brands continue to face pressure to demonstrate progress in reducing landfill contributions.

stories.title: India garment makers reduce reliance on US market
stories.summary: Indian garment exporters are seeking new trade pacts in the UK and EU following a 10 percent year-on-year decline in exports to the US. With US tariffs currently reaching 10 percent under Section 301, manufacturers are diversifying their reach to mitigate the impact of trade policy shifts.

stories.title: Cartier owner Richemont's jewellery growth slows to 14% in the second quarter as gold costs bite - MLQ.ai
Apparel exports show signs of revival
stories.summary: India’s ready-made garment exports rose 20 percent in October 2026 compared to the previous year. Apparel Export Promotion Council chairman Dr. A. Sakthivel cited a strong pipeline of overseas orders as evidence of an industry revival. The current priority is ensuring sufficient workforce availability to meet demand.

stories.title: A.W.A.K.E. Mode Founder Natalia Alaverdian Exits as Creative Director - The Business of Fashion
Trader Joe's tote bags become luxury items in Europe
stories.summary: Trader Joe's canvas tote bags, which retail for as little as $2.99 in the United States, are being resold for thousands of dollars in international markets. The bags have become fashion statements in cities where the grocery chain does not operate a single store.

stories.title: TFG London opens Fivefold multi-brand store in Inverness
stories.summary: TFG London has launched its first Fivefold multi-brand store in Inverness, housing brands including Hobbs, Whistles, Phase Eight and Karen Millen. The company says the concept is designed to make fashion one of life's pleasures. A second location is scheduled to open in Bournemouth later this month.

stories.title: Genlook releases AI virtual try-on model
stories.summary: Grenoble-based Genlook has released an AI platform that generates a photorealistic image of any catalog garment on a shopper's body in under 10 seconds. The model requires only a single photo upload from the user to visualize the clothing on their own frame.

stories.title: Mercari US growth slows as competitors offer shipping deals
stories.summary: Mercari US reported that gross merchandise volume growth slowed to 0.3 percent in the first quarter of fiscal 2027. The company attributed the decline to aggressive shipping promotions from rival resale marketplaces. Monthly active users fell by 2 percent compared to the same period last year.

stories.title: So/Facet raises Rs 10 crore seed funding to build premium LGD jewellery retail brand - The Retail Jeweller India
Snitch tests AI-powered mirrors in Indian stores
stories.summary: Fashion retailer Snitch is beta testing AI-powered digital mirrors at select Indian outlets in partnership with Flickd. The initiative aims to assess how digital fitting technology influences customer engagement and product discovery. Shoppers are currently using the mirrors to preview different outfits while browsing in store.

stories.title: Frontier Raas expands retail presence to Ahmedabad
stories.summary: Occasionwear brand Frontier Raas has opened a new store in Ahmedabad, marking its entry into the Gujarat market. The 72-year-old company focuses on traditional Indian textiles and bridal couture. Actor Kangana Ranaut inaugurated the location, which serves consumers seeking attire for weddings and festivals.

stories.title: Checkout optimization gains focus in Indian e-commerce
stories.summary: Checkout optimization has become a priority for Indian e-commerce businesses across fashion and lifestyle sectors. Platforms are being deployed to simplify the purchase journey and reduce cart abandonment. The goal is to improve customer experience and increase the number of successful transactions on retail websites.

stories.title: HBM Nigeria provides sewing equipment to fashion graduates
stories.summary: HBM Nigeria has provided industrial sewing machines and start-up equipment to graduates of a three-month fashion design training program. The initiative, run in partnership with the Awesome Empowerment Foundation, aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship by equipping participants with practical tailoring skills.

stories.title: Comparing fashion design and fashion communication careers
stories.summary: Students preparing for NIFT 2027 are weighing the differences between fashion design and fashion communication. While design focuses on the creation of garments and fabrics, communication centers on branding, styling and visual storytelling. The two paths offer distinct roles within the fashion industry.

stories.title: Brandman Retail plans expansion into smaller Indian cities
stories.summary: Brandman Retail aims to reach 50 stores by March 2027, targeting tier-II and tier-III cities. The company reported revenue of Rs 162.41 crore in FY26, a 20 percent increase from the previous year. Growth was driven by an expanded portfolio of international sportswear and lifestyle brands.
